description: Unreal Engine 5.8 editor (dev-slim) — full Linux editor and build tools for real-time 3D, virtual production and pixel streaming projects.
notes:
Requires GPU agent (gpu_count >= 1) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit installed on the agent host. Will not run usably on CPU-only agents.

IMPORTANT: ghcr.io/epicgames/unreal-engine is NOT anonymously pullable. The Kasm agent must hold GHCR credentials for an account linked to the EpicGames GitHub organisation, or the pull fails.

First pull is ~49 GB — allow time and disk headroom on the agent.

Projects persist in /{username}/unreal (bound to ~/Documents). The shader cache is persisted separately at ~/.config/Epic; without it shaders recompile on every session.

This image is an Epic image, not a Kasm image — it carries no KasmVNC layer. If no desktop appears on launch, a wrapper image (FROM kasmweb/core-ubuntu-jammy + engine files) is required; see docker-builds.
